translation_policy: Translate only the complete English six-page edition in the multilingual original; preserve all native equations, variables, numerical data, page geometry and original source anomalies. No editorial notes added to the PDF.

source_anomalies_kept.description: The acceleration unit is printed m/c squared in the original; kept in its original native glyphs.
The Earth orbital radius is printed as 1.50 x 10^8 without a length unit; native expression preserved.

bitmap_language_translation.method: PDF background restoration and Korean text overlay. Original visible feature masks are excluded from the new paint. No source image is replaced, resampled, or additionally painted.
bitmap_language_translation.dark_background: Smooth local background estimated from surrounding RGB pixels; changes stay inside reviewed language regions.
bitmap_language_translation.font_metadata: Bitmap labels contain no font metadata. Serif/sans family, size and baseline are measured estimates based on observed original ink and reference-family glyph metrics; matching Noto CJK serif/sans is embedded.
bitmap_language_translation.alignment_note: The complete Korean Jupiter caption uses the original English caption right edge within the same language box, preserving estimated size and baseline and clearing the planet surface.
bitmap_language_translation.feature_masks: Explicit conservative planet-surface bounds, neutral bright pixels covering the gray/white asteroid dots, and coloured orbit pixels. Masks deliberately retain some neighbouring non-language pixels as well.
